node.title: Re^5: making a loop script with a remote URL call faster
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If the timing needs to be quite exact

Relevant threads may be [id://11109264] and [id://11120630] in which my posts [id://11109343|here] and [id://11120664|here] demonstrate [man://clock_nanosleep;2|clock_nanosleep(2)] in [doc://Time::HiRes]. Both don't handle the case of the task lasting longer than the interval, though.
